text:
maya-docs: Heads-up: I opened a PR to reconcile the audit schema migration guide and add language for SOC2-friendly phrasing + SDK redaction examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4301.

samir-docs: Thanks — quick scan. Main edits will be in the migration checklist and the sample SDK snippets. Can we avoid showing real-looking emails or SSNs in examples? Use placeholders.

maya-docs: Yep — swapped to tokenized_actor_id and placeholders like {PERSONAL_ID}. Also added a compact Node and Python snippet for redaction rules.

dorian-sec: Security review: please include a one-line requirement that exported bundles use envelope encryption and a note that reversible masking requires customer-managed keys. Also prefer key ARN examples for KMS.

maya-docs: Added a KMS example arn and the reversible masking sentence.

compliance_ella: Compliance ask: avoid definitive language such as "we never". Use "Redwood does not retain exported bundles beyond the configured export retention window (example: 90 days) for hosted plans" and "Private: customer-managed". Also, in the 'what we log' table mark IP as jurisdiction-dependent.

maya-docs: Rephrased per compliance and updated the table. Inserted example values 90/365 as placeholders that will be finalized.

infra-owen: Ops: migration examples should include --concurrency and a note about rate limits. Also add an example for exporting to a presigned URL in case customers prefer not to use S3 directly.

maya-docs: Included --concurrency 6 and a presigned URL example (aws s3 presign flow).

samir-docs: Can you paste the redaction SDK snippet inline? I'll check formatting.

maya-docs: Pasted snippets below.

Node redaction example:
```js
await client.audit.setRedactionPolicy({
  paths: ["$.details.{PERSONAL_ID}", "$.details.financial_token"],
  mode: "mask",
  keyArn: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01" // example
})
```

Python export command example:
```bash
redwood audit export --filter "event_type = 'dataset.access'" \
  --dest s3://acme-corp/audit-bundle.tar \
  --kms-key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 \
  --concurrency 6
# optionally create presigned URL
aws s3 presign s3://acme-corp/audit-bundle.tar --expires-in 3600
```

Migration checklist added: update consumer code to read new event_type, check redaction policy, run redwood-audit-migrate --concurrency 6, validate with audit-e2e-tests.

compliance_ella: One small wording request: change "customer-managed" to "customer-managed (no hosted default)" for Private deployments.

maya-docs: Done. Also added a short sample redacted event for clarity:
```json
{
  "event_type": "dataset.download",
  "timestamp": "2027-01-15T12:00:00Z",
  "actor": "tokenized_actor_id:tok_42",
  "resource": "/datasets/abc",
  "details": {"file": "report.csv"},
  "redacted_fields": ["details.{PERSONAL_ID}"]
}
```

dorian-sec: LGTM. Add the one-line caution: "Do not export unredacted tenant-sensitive data without encryption and RBAC approval."

samir-docs: Formatting nit: use "event_type" consistently (not "type"). Also add a tiny Go example for setting a policy.

maya-docs: Added Go snippet and normalized field names.

docs-bot: PR #4301  checks: docs lint passed; link-checker flagged no failures.

maya-docs: Final approvals requested: @compliance_ella, @dorian-sec. If no objections I'll merge in an hour.

compliance_ella: Approved (example values OK to ship with TODO to finalize).

dorian-sec: Security approved.

maya-docs: Merging now. Thanks all! :rocket: 

docs-bot: PR #4301 merged by maya-docs  changelog updated."
